text:
Simon Lau: Hey @people-ops — quick heads up that my last day will be Fri 04/03. Need to confirm timeline for SSO deprovision, VPN, and whether I can keep my personal copies of a few non-company datasets. Also got a question about COBRA timing since I start at the new company 04/20.
Ana P: Thanks for the notice, Simon. We can do SSO/VPN offboarding the evening of your last day. Can you confirm equipment return and whether you want a pickup or shipping label? :package:
Simon Lau: I have the company Mac and dongles. Pickup would be easiest. Also about licenses — can JetBrains/Figma be transferred to my personal email temporarily? I have two active paid months left.
Matt R: FYI from eng — please make sure all personal forks are transferred and remove any personal tokens in repos. We can audit org membership before deprovision.
IT Deprovision Bot: Auto-schedule: pickup request created. Pickup window: Mon 04/06 — Wed 04/08. To print label:
```
curl -X POST https://ship.example.com/labels -d '{"asset_id":"MAC-2981","addr":"{{user_address}}"}'
```
Reply YES to confirm pickup window.
Simon Lau: Confirmed. YES to pickup 04/07.
Tess (HR): COBRA note — your active coverage ends last day of employment (04/03). We send COBRA packet within 7 business days with election window (60 days). If your new employer offers coverage on 04/20, COBRA can bridge until then but you must elect and pay for coverage retro to 04/04. I'll DM you the packet.
Simon Lau: OK thanks. Any proration on HSA contribution or 401k vesting questions? My RSU vesting cliff is next vesting cycle on 04/15 — will that be impacted?
Ana P: Vesting note — standard practice: RSUs vest according to grant schedule; departure before a vesting date usually means you don't get the upcoming tranche unless stated in grant. I'll loop in Comp to confirm if there's any pro-rated payout.
Matt R: For repos — quick checklist: transfer any personal forks of internal repos, revoke personal deploy keys, delete cached credentials from CI. If you tag me on the PRs you want migrated I can help.
Security Bot: Please rotate any API keys you used in non-personal services and confirm removal of SSH keys from github.com/org. Command to list keys:
```
ssh-add -l
# then remove with
ssh-keygen -f ~/.ssh/id_rsa -p
```
Simon Lau: Got it. I'll start removing tokens tonight and ping Matt for repo moves. Thanks everyone. When do you want me for the exit interview?
Ana P: Exit interview scheduled: Thu 04/02 at 3pm PT — calendar invite sent. We'll do SSO deprovision 8pm PT on Fri 04/03 unless you need exceptions. I'll post a short checklist DM with next steps. :slightly_smiling_face:
Simon Lau: Perfect — appreciate the help.
